thread:
sally-cust: Hi, we started seeing SSO failures right after our cert rotation. Users get 401 on callback to ACS. Not sure if this is our IdP or something on Redwood side.

sally-cust: Error from browser network tab:  POST https://app.example.com/saml/acs 401
sally-cust: Our IdP logs show 'Destination mismatch' for the AuthnResponse. We rotated signing certs ~10:15 UTC.

tanvi-support: Hey @sally-cust — sorry about this. Can you paste the IdP's metadata XML and the ACS URL you configured? Also any RelayState examples.

sally-cust: ACS configured in our SSO settings: `https://app.example.com/saml/acs` (no trailing slash). IdP metadata attached as XML (pasted below):
```
<saml2:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.customer.com">
  ...
  <md:AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.example.com/saml/acs/" index="0"/>
  ...
</saml2:EntityDescriptor>
```

sally-cust: Notice the IdP metadata has an ACS with trailing slash. Not sure why it was created that way during provisioning.

kevin-eng: Thanks — that Relay/ACS mismatch would trigger 'Destination mismatch' on our SAML validation. Our ACS stored in tenant config is without trailing slash, so signature destination check fails. That explains the 401. Two immediate options: update IdP metadata to remove trailing slash, or accept both ACS variants on our side.

oliver-oncall: Quick note — we saw a related regression yesterday where our GCP LB rewrite was normalizing paths and adding a trailing slash when Health Check header present. Could be interacting with cert rotation timing.

tanvi-support: Can you run a quick check for repro? From your machine, curl the IdP's metadata and show the ACS Location element.

sally-cust: Done. The Location includes trailing slash. Our SSO provisioning tool (okta automation) pushed metadata during rotation.

kevin-eng: Repro steps I used locally:
1) Send SP-initiated AuthNRequest to IdP.
2) IdP returns AuthnResponse signed and Destination set to `https://app.example.com/saml/acs/` (trailing slash).
3) Our SP rejects it because tenant config stored `https://app.example.com/saml/acs`.

kevin-eng: Temporary workaround: add `https://app.example.com/saml/acs/` as an alias in the tenant SSO settings (we can add an alternate accepted ACS). That will accept the Destination value while we push a proper fix.

tanvi-support: I'm provisioning that alias for you now. Also advising customer to update IdP metadata to remove trailing slash for consistency.

sally-cust: Thanks — after you added the alias auths started working for some users. Still seeing a handful of failures — maybe cached metadata at IdP or CDN.

oliver-oncall: If there are intermittent failures, check if any intermediate proxies are rewriting host/path. Also verify the IdP started serving the updated metadata (no cached old XML).

kevin-eng: Long term plan: we'll change SAML destination validation to normalize trailing slash differences for ACS host+path equivalence (only for known-allowed tenant aliases) to avoid breaking on minor provisioning differences. I'll open an RFC and schedule a small patch to relax Destination check semantics while keeping signature verification intact.

tanvi-support: Filed workaround and customer notified. I'll keep this thread updated and close once we have deploy plan. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
